Terms of Service &
Data Privacy Agreement

By using this offline disaster response web application (Project AMPING / ANDAM), you explicitly consent to the collection, processing, and temporary storage of your personal information (such as your full name, exact GPS coordinates, medical status, and household details) strictly for emergency response, rescue operations, and tactical communications in compliance with the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (R.A. 10173).

1. Purpose & Scope of Usage:
Your data will exclusively be used by the LGU Command Center, local Barangay Administrators, and dispatched responders (Ambulance, Rescue, Evacuation, Relief teams) to locate and assist you during a declared state of emergency or disaster.

2. Offline Mesh Network & Security:
We implement strict localized security measures. Because this operates as a localized tactical mesh network (using LoRa and Local Wi-Fi), your data remains within the immediate rescue system framework. It is temporarily cached on your device and the responder nodes, and is NOT broadcasted openly on the public internet. Data is securely synced to the cloud only when official LGU terminals regain internet access.

3. Built-in Safety Guide:
The app includes a built-in offline safety guide. It does not use Artificial Intelligence. What you type into the guide stays on your device and is not sent to anyone.

4. Data Retention & Deletion:
Your tactical emergency requests, chat logs, and GPS tracks will be archived securely by the CDRRMC for post-operation reporting. To protect your privacy, all operational data is purged from local responder devices and centralized according to official LGU retention policies once disaster operations officially conclude.

5. Prohibited Acts & Liability:
This network is STRICTLY for official LGU Emergency use. Abuse, pranks, spamming the community chat, or triggering false SOS alarms consumes critical bandwidth and endangers lives. Violators will be permanently banned from the network and may face legal prosecution under applicable emergency response laws.

Emergency Guidelines

🚑 Ambulance: Medical emergencies, severe injuries, heart attacks, or active labor.

🚤 Evacuation: Pre-emptive. You are currently safe but need transport before floodwaters/danger rises.

🚁 Rescue: Immediate life-threatening danger. You are trapped and need physical extraction.

📦 Relief: Requesting survival supplies, food, or clean water during calamities.

⚠️ Hazard: Reporting fallen trees, live wires, fires, or blocked roads that affect the community.

Improve GPS Accuracy

Rescuers need your exact location. If your GPS shows "Low Accuracy" (Red), please do this immediately:

1. Step Outside or Near a Window

Thick concrete walls and metal roofs block satellite signals. Get a clear view of the sky.

2. Turn on Wi-Fi

Even if you don't connect to a network, keeping Wi-Fi turned ON helps your phone triangulate your exact position faster.

3. Enable "Precise Location"

Ensure Location Services are fully enabled in your phone settings, specifically allowing "Precise Location" for your web browser.
